86: To bend the joints of their fingers - [the priests] spread their fingers while they are reciting the benediction, and after they finish they close their fists like other people. The "joints of the finger" are the segments that are bent and straightened out.
The one who calls is not permitted - the prayer leader who calls out "Priests" [kohanim] in order that they turn around in order to recite the benediction.
Amen - of the blessing of Thanksgiving.
